name: pe_to_shellcode_linux
description: The PE to shellcode converter is a powerful tool for penetration testing and vulnerability analysis that allows you to convert any non .NET 64-bit Windows executable file to shellcode. This is based on hasherezade's pe_to_shellcode for Windows (https://github.com/hasherezade/pe_to_shellcode).

name: ShellcodeStdio
description: An extensible framework for easily writing debuggable, compiler optimized, position independent, x86/x64 shellcode for windows platforms.  For basic usage see main.cpp

name: bddisasm
description: bddisasm is a fast, lightweight, x86/x64 instruction decoder.  The project also features a fast, basic, x86/x64 instruction emulator, designed specifically to detect shellcode-like behavior.

name: Apple-ARM64-shellcode
description: Assembly code for bind shells and reverse shells on Apple systems based on ARM64 processors (Apple Silicon).
